name: @open-design/standalone
description: Shell-neutral Open Design Web and daemon product lifecycle.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-update... build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-proto build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-runtime build && tsx ./esbuild.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @open-design/closure-update... build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-proto build && pnpm --filter @open-design/standalone-runtime build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
